leads.summary: The new hover fixture and source assertions do not exercise Bar.showTooltip, so they can pass with the original event-order bug restored under an equivalent guard
leads.consequence: A plausible implementation that adds `if (target.tooltipHovered !== true) return` ahead of the new early check still passes the bar-test source regex (it rules out only the literal old expression). The QML test passes independently because fakeBar.showTooltip, not Bar.qml:1115-1143, handles requests. For media or active-window, MouseArea.onEntered can arrive before the root HoverHandler reports hover, and this mutant silently suppresses the tooltip again. Add an integration test for the production state machine on a real entry event, or a targeted fixture with observable queue and timers that cannot bypass the production guard.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (F2); corroboration only

leads.summary: Public tooltip APIs still omit the now-essential live-hover requirement for custom Item targets
leads.consequence: A third-party or custom QML widget that follows the documented `bar.showTooltip(target, text)` API with a plain Item target will have its tooltip silently discarded: the deferred Bar.qml guard accepts only `target.tooltipHovered === true`. The PR equips BarWidget roots but does not make generic Item roots or their subtargets qualify. Document that targets must expose a reactive tooltipHovered property, and show using BarWidget/WidgetButton or a MouseArea.containsMouse binding, together with matching hideTooltip on exit.

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** the change resolves #12610 for `omarchy.media`, `omarchy.active-window` and other widgets that pass their `BarWidget` root to `bar.showTooltip`. No regressions were found in the tested scope. One documentation gap from the issue remains, plus an optional test improvement and a small optional follow-up.

### Verified: both halves of the change are needed

In Qt 6.11.2, the hover enter reaches the widget's child `MouseArea` before the passive `HoverHandler` on the `BarWidget` root. Inside `onEntered`, the new `tooltipHovered` is therefore still `false`. The old synchronous guard in `showTooltip` would reject the request; the check in `Qt.callLater` runs after the handler has updated.

```text
pointer enters media widget
  MouseArea.onEntered -> bar.showTooltip(root, text)
      old guard: tooltipHovered === true fails, request dropped
        (base BarWidget: property undefined; head BarWidget: still false,
         HoverHandler not updated yet)
      head Bar.qml: request queued
  HoverHandler.hovered -> true
  Qt.callLater check: tooltipHovered == true -> request accepted
  400 ms timer, target still hovered -> tooltip shown
```

Offscreen harness with the tooltip members of `Bar.qml` copied verbatim and a media-style `BarWidget` in a `ModuleSlot`-like wrapper:

| `BarWidget.qml` / `Bar.qml` logic | Tooltip shown |
|---|---|
| head / head | yes |
| head / base | no |
| base / either | no (reproduces #12610) |

**Verified** on the head in the same harness:
- The tooltip stays up while hovered, hides on leave and hands over correctly between adjacent widgets.
- Rapid enter and leave leaves nothing pending or shown.
- `visible = false`, `opacity = 0` and destruction clear a shown tooltip immediately, without clearing another widget's tooltip. Hiding and destruction also clear a request that is still pending (tested; for `opacity = 0` this follows from source).
- `WidgetButton`, a `WidgetButton` inside a `BarWidget`, a third-party `BarWidget` going through `PluginBarApi`, and a null or destroyed `bar` behave as expected, with no QML warnings.
- `bar-widget-tooltip-test.sh`, `bar-test.sh`, `media-test.sh` and `clock-test.sh` pass on the head. Both new test files fail against the base code (3 of the 4 QML test functions fail; the `WidgetButton` one passes, as expected).

### Tooltip requirement is still undocumented for custom modules

`targetTooltipHovered` (`shell/plugins/bar/Bar.qml:399-401`) still requires `target.tooltipHovered === true`. `shell/plugins/bar/README.md` tells custom QML modules to be a plain `Item` and lists `bar.showTooltip(target, text)` (line 164) with no requirement; `docs/omarchy-shell.md` (lines 404-407) says the same. A custom module that calls `bar.showTooltip(root, ...)` from a plain `Item` root still gets no tooltip and no log message.

**Impact:** issue #12610 is titled after this undocumented requirement, and its second option asked for documentation. With the PR marked "Fixes #12610", third-party module authors who follow the documented API still hit the silent failure.

**Suggested change:** add one sentence in both documents: the target must be a `BarWidget` or `WidgetButton`, or expose a `tooltipHovered` bool that is true while hovered, and it must be visible with non-zero opacity. Optionally, log a one-time `console.warn` in `showTooltip` when `tooltipHovered` is undefined.

**Optional test improvement:** the QML test's `fakeBar.showTooltip` always defers through `Qt.callLater` and never runs the production guard. With `Bar.qml` reverted to the base (and `BarWidget.qml` kept at the head), all 4 QML test functions still pass; only the source regex in `bar-test.sh` fails. That regex pins the exact new and old guard text, so a synchronous hover check written any other way would pass it. A test that drives the real `showTooltip`/`hideTooltip` state machine (for example after moving it into a small non-visual component that `Bar.qml` creates) with a child `MouseArea` would catch a regression of the event-order fix.

**Optional follow-up:** unlike `WidgetButton`, which hides its tooltip before acting on a press, the media and active-window `MouseArea` handlers do not call `hideTooltip` on click or scroll, and the tooltip text is captured in `onEntered`. Now that these tooltips appear, scrolling or middle-clicking to the next track leaves the previous title shown until the pointer leaves (inferred from source, not observed on a desktop). Calling `bar.hideTooltip(root)` at the top of the `onClicked` handlers (and the media widget's `onWheel`) would avoid this.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of head `c077137` against base `3faafba` (current `quattro` tip), with Qt 6.11.2 delivery order checked in qtdeclarative source and offscreen. The PR's four listed test scripts ran in an isolated sandbox on the head (the QML test offscreen); the new and changed test files also ran against base code. The harness results come from a copy of the tooltip members of `Bar.qml`, not the full `Bar.qml`, which needs Quickshell and Hyprland. Not tested: a live compositor (real Wayland hover, popup stacking), vertical bars, multiple monitors, and the full `test/shell` suite.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.

**Opt out:** To stop receiving these reviews, reply to this comment saying so.
